caption_draft: Left: the grammatical mood swap moves teacher-forced NLL in the same direction under a short and a long frame across 16 models (Spearman rho = +0.90), so the effect is not an artefact of frame length. Right: on the same swap, where the ground truth is grammatical rather than judged, the Warriner dominance lexicon is silent on 54/85 cross-tier pairs and, on 26/31 of the pairs where it does move, ranks the polite request as the MORE dominant text --- the cheap ruler does not merely lack power here, it points the wrong way.
